k6.description: Grafana k6 MCP (k6 x mcp). Optional — smoke/heal uses CLI k6 run for HTML reports. Set enabled true and NFE_K6_MCP=mcp only if you need MCP tools in-bot.

playwright.description: Optional Playwright MCP for interactive browser tools. Pipeline uses in-process Playwright+CDP by default. Pin version — do not use @latest.

chrome-devtools.description: Optional Chrome DevTools MCP for live network/perf traces. Not used as the capture layer. Pin version — do not use @latest.

atlassian.description: Atlassian Rovo MCP (Jira/Confluence). Interactive Studio use only — the NFE Jira worker uses REST. Pin mcp-remote; do not use @latest.
